According to [[Kaliyo Djannis]], the '''Cannibal-demon of the Summit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who rose to power after conquering a numbeer of tribes on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] generations before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The warlord's descendants were declared a "cursed family" by other Rattataki, and he had a great-granddaughter named Kaliyo Djannis. However, Djannis was a notorious liar; the veracity of her stories about her family was unconfirmed.
